product.title: West Maui Mountains ATV Adventure

description.text: Explore Maui's rugged terrain during this thrilling ATV tour. After an orientation to the vehicle, take off for the top of the valley, where you can view the waterfalls from a distance. Stops include West Maui Mountains, Scenic Viewpoint. Traveling via ATV allows you access to parts of the valley that traditional tour vehicles can't reach. Ideal for visitors basing on Maui who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
